name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 26 - Am 52
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 26f. Calls for more funding for the programmes addressing remoteness and insularity (POSEI), the restoration of a POSEI scheme for fisheries and the creation of a new POSEI scheme for transport, in order to protect and raise the profile of the outermost regions by means of financial resources, programmes and measures (whether permanent or exceptional) supporting insular regional economies;
